title: RealEstateAiToolsSchema
description: JSON Schema defining tools available to the Autonomous Real Estate CRM AI Agent Loop

create_deal.description: Create a new sales/rental deal linked to a contact and optionally a property

contact_id.description: ID of the contact to link the deal to

title.description: Title of the deal (e.g. John Doe - Studio Pearl)

value.description: The estimated financial value of the deal

property_id.description: Optional ID of the property associated with this deal

notes.description: Any initial notes about the deal

update_deal_stage.description: Move an existing deal to a new stage in the real estate sales pipeline

deal_id.description: ID of the deal to update

stage.description: The target pipeline stage to move the deal into

send_sms_via_twilio.description: Send an automated qualification or follow-up SMS message to a contact phone number using Twilio

contact_id.description: ID of the contact to send the SMS to

message.description: The plain text body content of the SMS

send_email.description: Send a professional email/proposal to a contact

body.description: HTML or plain text body content of the email

schedule_viewing.description: Schedule a property viewing appointment/booking slot for a contact and property

contact_id.description: ID of the contact viewing the property

property_id.description: ID of the property to be viewed

scheduled_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp representing the booking date and time

deal_id.description: Optional associated Deal ID to link the booking to

pull_property_comps.description: Retrieve comparable active or sold properties matching criteria within a 1-mile radius for valuation

property_id.description: The base Property ID to pull comps against

radius_miles.description: The geographical radius in miles around the base property
